question_or_proposition: Does 'Report' in the Whole Effluent Toxicity testing table VALUE column for Ceriodaphnia dubia and Pimephales promelas establish that no enforceable numeric effluent limitation applies to those WET parameters at Outfall 001, such that reported WET measurements are subject only to reporting and not to numeric limit exceedance comparison?
required_context: WET table on page 4 (VALUE, measurement frequency, and sample type columns for Ceriodaphnia dubia and Pimephales promelas)
Footnotes (2) and (3) attached to the WET table
Part II WET testing requirements referenced in footnote (3)
source_locator: gcc/final_permit.pdf, Page 4, Section part_i, WET table VALUE column
notes: Purpose A requires distinguishing enforceable numeric discharge limits from report-only monitoring. The nominated span is the VALUE-column entry for both WET species; resolving its meaning determines whether WET results enter numeric limit comparison. Monitoring applicability for Purpose B is driven by the frequency column and footnotes rather than VALUE. Purpose C classifications for missing WET results depend primarily on whether monitoring was required at the evaluated period, not on the VALUE-column notation alone.
